senses.gloss: f.(b. h.;ישן, v. Halévy , Revue des Et. Juives XI, 1885, p. 64) year.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 55a:3">Ber. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>שלשה … ש׳ טובה וכ׳</he> three things must be prayed for: a good king, a good year, and a good dream.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:1">R. Hash. I, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>ראש הש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="T00031"><he>רֹאשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 2a:7">Ib. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>עלתה לו ש׳</he> it is counted as one year of his reign (his second year begins).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 5:2:7">Y. Yoma V, 42ᶜ</cite> top; Bab.

<cite ref="Yoma 39b:13">Ib. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>אותה ש׳ … בש׳ זו הוא מת</he> (on the Day of Atonement of) the year in which Simon the righteous died, he said to them, in this year he (euphem. for I) shall die.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97a:10">Snh. 97ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 9a:5">Ab. Zar. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>ששת אלפים ש׳ וכ׳</he> the world will last six thousand years.
<cite ref="Nazir 5a:10">Naz. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>אותה ש׳ … שנת עשר וכ׳</he> the year in which they asked for a king was the tenth year of office of Samuel &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 1:1">Par. I, 1</cite> <he>בת שְׁנָתָהּ</he> in her first year; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="U01596"><he>שָׁנִים</he></cite>, constr. <he>שְׁנוֹת</he> (<he>שְׁנֵי</he>). Naz. l. c. <he>ימים שאין עמהן ש׳</he> ‘days’ in the Scriptures to which the word ‘years’ is not attached; <he>זה שיש עמו ש׳</he> this passage (<cite ref="Genesis 41:1">Gen. XLI, 1</cite>) where ‘years’ is combined with days.

<cite ref="Yoma 71a:17">Yoma 71ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 3:2">Prov. III, 2</cite>) <he>וכי יש ש׳ של חיים ויש ש׳ שאינן וכ׳</he> are there years of life, and years of no life? <he>אלו שְׁנוֹתָיו של אדם וכ׳</he> those are a man’s years which are changed for him from evil to good.

Sabb. 89ᵇ (ref. to כשנים, Is. I, 18) אם יהיו חטאיכם כש׳ הללו וכ׳ if your sins were as many as the years that have been arranged and have come down from the six days of creation until now, they shall become white &c.; Yalk. Is. 256; Y. Sabb. IX, 12ᵃ bot. כש׳ שבין וכ׳ as the years (required for travelling) between the heaven and the earth; כשְׁנֵי אבות as the years of the patriarchs; a. v. fr.—ברכת הש׳ (the blessing of the harvests of the year) birkhath hash-shanim, the ninth section of the Prayer of Benedictions (תְּפִלָּה).
